description: Land Acquisition - Udugannawa watta, Pathadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District and 5 others
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding compensation deposits for acquired lands. It contains detailed land descriptions including names, plan numbers, lot numbers, extents, and boundary locations. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative notices.
